pages.text: A spell that passed structure, parameter and engine validation. It stores the root, every node and all parameters, and can be cast from an Assembly Wand.

pages.title: Editing and examples
pages.text: Return it to a table to edit. Changes may make it unformed again without losing its structure.$(br2)The Built-in Spells creative tab supplies 28 editable L2Magic examples for casting or studying.
